n1.speaker: narrator
n1.text: The Chair. On the seat, a single file. Your name is on it.

nope.speaker: narrator
nope.text: The Chair. Black wood, gold leaf, worn at the arms by hands that have not touched it in decades.

sit.speaker: narrator
sit.text: You sit. The room goes quiet in two directions at once. Two presences arrive, and do not knock.

p1.speaker: narrator
p1.text: The Principal: 'You broke a Compact that kept a peace. Tell Us what you will keep instead.'

c1.speaker: narrator
c1.text: The Counterparty, amused: 'Choose carefully, Chancellor. We both remember the Tally War.'

choices.text: Keep the Rubric. Order, honestly kept.
Charter Purgatory as a third realm.

e1.speaker: narrator
e1.text: The Rubric stands, without violet ink. Fewer miracles, fewer crimes. The queue moves. The Gates stay shut to bribes.

effects.title: The Rubric Kept
effects.text: Order, honestly kept. The Border endures. (The work goes on; so can you.)

e2.speaker: narrator
e2.text: Every file is judged by a person again. It is slower, kinder, and dangerous. Both sides grumble. Neither marches.

effects.title: Discretion Restored
effects.text: Justice, one soul at a time. The backlog grows; so does mercy. (Play on.)

e3.speaker: narrator
e3.text: The DEFERRED are no longer waiting. Purgatory is a realm, with its own name. The Residents weep in the Cells, then open them.

effects.title: The Third Realm
effects.text: Purgatory chartered. Nobody is merely deferred any more. (Play on.)

after.speaker: narrator
after.text: The Chair is warm now. The file with your name on it waits. You will open it one day. Not today.
